diagnosis.fix_evidence: Restrict all three R33 fallback exits for CanReprojectFiniteResultHudPlane exact source family to the original draw, leaving the successful R33TryHud binocular path untouched.

diagnosis.runtime_limit: Without Quest3/VDXR no conclusion that on-device double-image symptom is resolved; actual game visual behavior UNTESTED.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Physical two-eye R33 success remains authoritative; absent proof, the game draws once, never coerced into a cached world eye WVP.
diagnosis.original_evidence: Original OutRun 2006 +TIME stage extension E8 source hooks in hooks_uiscaling.cpp tag sprites/numeric D3DX or the original SpriteNode with StageExtensionTime; GPU draw is actually issued later at Flush/End or queue replay. When R30 R84 cannot classify this draw as finite stereo HUD, R33Dispatch previously selected R31 fast-world or R29 fallback, potentially borrowing the prior road WVP.
source_trace: Native stage extension sprite E8/printf glyph hooks create exact StageExtensionTime ScreenHud tag for original D3DX Draw or SpriteNode.
R33GuardStereoRasterState snapshots physical draw producer, R30ClassifyScreenSpace chooses finite two-eye HUD and R33TryHud performs actual left/right Draw after c64 eye matrices.
When GPU-eye proof is absent or unhandled, R33 must keep exactly one original game draw rather than invoking cached R31FastWorld or R29 generic fallback.
